tool.name: GetOvertureFeatures
tool.summary: Download features from Overture Maps for a given spatial extent and save them to an output feature class. Supports all Overture feature types including segment, connector, place, building, and more. Optionally adds a primary_name or primary_category field during post-processing.

usage.bullet_item: Draw or supply a polygon extent to define the area of interest. The extent is automatically projected to WGS 84 if needed.
Select the Overture type to download (e.g. segment, connector, place, building).
The Add Primary Name option is available only for types that include a names column (e.g. place, segment, building).
The Add Primary Category option is available only for the place type.

param.name: extent
param.dialogReference: A polygon feature set or layer defining the spatial extent for downloading Overture features. If the coordinate system is not WGS 84, the extent is projected automatically.

param.name: out_fc
param.dialogReference: The output feature class where downloaded Overture features will be stored.

param.name: overture_type
param.dialogReference: The Overture Maps feature type to retrieve (e.g. segment, connector, place, building, land_use).

param.name: add_primary_name
param.dialogReference: When checked, parses the JSON-encoded names column and adds a primary_name text field containing the default name. Only available for types whose schema includes a names field.

param.name: add_primary_category
param.dialogReference: When checked, parses the JSON-encoded categories column and adds a primary_category text field. Only available for the place type.
